rounds.text: Lexus Granito is currently undergoing a significant fundamental transformation, evidenced by a massive 121% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E20]. This acceleration is not an isolated event, as the company has demonstrated a consistent upward trend in profitability with 28% growth over three years and 15% over five years [E19, E20]. The market is currently failing to price in this momentum, as the stock trades at a P/B of 1.57x compared to the sector benchmark of 2.09x [E7]. Furthermore, the company is trading at a P/E of 27.62x, which sits at a discount to the sector benchmark of 28.87x [E6]. The scanX signal engine confirms that the company is beginning to outperform expectations, with profit growth exceeding one-year price growth by 175% [E54]. Conceded: the company faces long-term sales contraction, with compounded sales growth at -5% over ten years and -18% over the trailing twelve months [E14, E17]. Conceded: the ROA of 0.96% remains significantly below the sector benchmark of 2.75% [E8].
